description: [Deprecated: use execute_dartql] Batch update multiple tasks matching a DartQL selector. Supports all task fields including relationships. CRITICAL: Always use dry_run=true first to preview changes!

dry_run.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to execute updates.

selector.description: DartQL WHERE clause (SQL-92 syntax). Operators: =, !=, <>, <, >, <=, >=, LIKE, IN, NOT IN, BETWEEN, IS NULL, CONTAINS. Use LIKE with % and _ wildcards for pattern matching (e.g., "title LIKE 'Task%'")

updates.description: Fields to update (partial DartTask object). Relationship arrays use full replacement semantics - set to [] to clear.

blocker_ids.description: IDs of tasks that block this task. Full replacement: set to [] to clear.

blocking_ids.description: IDs of tasks that this task is blocking. Full replacement: set to [] to clear.

duplicate_ids.description: IDs of tasks that are duplicates of this task. Full replacement: set to [] to clear.

related_ids.description: IDs of related tasks (loosely connected). Full replacement: set to [] to clear.

subtask_ids.description: IDs of tasks that are subtasks (children) of this task. Full replacement: set to [] to clear.

name: batch_update_tasks
